name: Team review board
description: A multi-persona panel reviews an idea: growth-strategist and finance-lead argue in parallel (step 1), the devil's advocate attacks their takes (step 2, it sees their results automatically), the orchestrator compiles a verdict — and you approve before it's saved. Shows: orchestrate + plugged-in agent nodes, persona skills, summarize mode, human-in-the-loop approval.

input.label: The idea or plan to review
input.placeholder: e.g. a paid tier for my CLI tool

nodes.label: growth take
nodes.task:
Assess this idea from a growth and market perspective: {{input}}
Give your five strongest points — audience, channel, timing, positioning, and the growth loop — 1-2 sentences each.

nodes.label: finance take
nodes.task:
Assess the unit economics and financial risks of: {{input}}
Cover pricing, costs, break-even, and the two biggest financial risks. Be concrete, no hedging.

nodes.label: devil's advocate
nodes.task:
Make the strongest possible case AGAINST: {{input}}
Attack the assumptions in the other panelists' takes (included in your context) and name how this dies.

nodes.text: Compile the panel into a verdict: where they agree, the sharpest disagreement, and a go / no-go recommendation with three concrete conditions.

nodes.prompt: Save the panel's verdict on “{{input}}” to workspace/reviews?
